paragraphs: R' Chana bar Sha’ina, [Avodah Zarah 75a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.75a.11); [Vayikra Rabbah 5:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Vayikra_Rabbah.5.2) has R' Yochanan bar Sha’ona.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rabbi Chana Sha’ina and, in an alternative, Rabbi Chana bar Sha’ina. He transmits a ruling from Rabbah bar bar Chana in Rabbi Yochanan’s name.

The linked Vayikra Rabbah gives Rabbi Levi speaking in the name of Rabbi Yochanan bar Sha’ona. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1848&lang=en) directs readers from Yochanan to his Chana entry, where he discusses their relationship as a possibility.
